photoshoot.note: Shots are generated by the Arena agent with generate_image (reference = media/designs/{SKU}.jpg), max 10 images per message, QUALITY over quantity. All 65 designs are MEN'S rings: worn shots on a man's hand, masculine styling throughout (user directive 5 Sep 2026). shot_{key}.jpg saved into media/{SKU}/. Every shot is stamped with the Shivaa logo (bottom-right) via tools/brand_logo.py, and each film carries the same logo overlay.
